title: dialog.open raises TypeError when refreshing an expired session
body:
## Environment

Running Lattice 3.1.5 on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS against eu-central-1.

## Steps

To reproduce:
- With the log window open, start refreshing an expired session.
- Use an input with an odd number of rows.
- Check the log window; the traceback appears there.

## Expected

No traceback; refreshing an expired session normally takes a few seconds.

## Actual

Only the last row fails; the rest process normally. Whatever the input size, it is always the last row that fails.

## Frequency

Reproduces only on the first run after login.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:45 in loop
lattice/ui/dialog.py:121 in on_login
lattice/auth/flow.py:57 in start
lattice/ui/dialog.py:267 in open
TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not callable
